data.question: persentase penduduk miskin di sulawesi tengah brp?

value.raw_question: persentase penduduk miskin di sulawesi tengah brp?

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T1.periode, AVG(T2.nilai) * 100.0 AS persentase
FROM provinsi AS T1
INNER JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T1.periode

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) OVER() AS persentase_miskin
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    provinsi
JOIN 
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN provinsi.nama = 'Sulawesi Tengah' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS persentase_miskin
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0);

  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  AVG(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM
  provinsi
JOIN
  nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
JOIN
  kamus_istilah ON kamus_istilah.istilah = 'penduduk_miskin'
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.kode

    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
